_comment: Every art asset the game pulls from a CC0 library, in one reviewable file.
Kept as data rather than hard-coded so adding a road surface or a skybox is a
one-line diff that a reviewer can check the licence of, and so a clean clone can
rebuild the whole art set with one command.
resolution: Poly Haven serves 1k/2k/4k/8k. 1k is the mobile default - a 4k road
texture costs 16x the memory for detail no phone screen resolves at 90 km/h.
maps: Poly Haven names vary per asset. 'Diffuse' is albedo, 'nor_gl' is an
OpenGL-convention normal map (which is what Unity expects; nor_dx is inverted
green and will light backwards), 'rough' is roughness, 'arm' packs
AO/roughness/metallic into one texture - preferred on mobile because it is one
source 'direct' is the generic escape hatch for anything without a resolver API -
fonts, audio, model packs. It REQUIRES a sha256 and refuses bytes that do not match,
because a hand-written URL is mutable and shipping whatever is behind it today is a
supply-chain hole on the technical side of the same problem the licence allow-list

assets.origin: Google Fonts / Oswald (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
assets.use: HUD numerals and body labels - condensed, legible at a glance
